parameters.name: AcceleratorType
parameters.description:
The accelerator type. Valid values:

- CPU

- GPU

If omitted, this operation returns nodes of all accelerator types.

parameters.name: FilterByQuotaId
parameters.description: When used with `ResourceGroupIds`, this parameter further filters the results to include only nodes from the specified resource quota.

parameters.name: FilterByResourceGroupIds
parameters.description: When used with `QuotaId`, this parameter further filters the results to include only nodes from the specified resource groups.

parameters.name: GPUType
parameters.description: The GPU type. Fuzzy matching is supported.

parameters.name: NodeNames
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of node names. Only nodes with names that match this list are returned.

parameters.name: NodeStatuses
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of node statuses. If this parameter is omitted, this operation returns nodes of all statuses.

parameters.name: NodeTypes
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of node specifications. If this parameter is omitted, this operation returns nodes of all specifications.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `desc`: Descending

- `asc`: Ascending

parameters.name: OrderInstanceIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of order IDs.

parameters.name: OrderStatuses
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of order statuses.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The first page is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page.

parameters.name: QuotaId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource quota that contains the nodes.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupIds
parameters.description:
A comma-separated list of resource group IDs. You must specify either this parameter or `QuotaId`.
Constraints:

1. The user ID of the request must match the user ID associated with the specified resource groups.

2. All specified resource groups must be of the same type.

3. All specified resource groups must be in the same VPC.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the results.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return resource usage information. This parameter applies only when `QuotaId` is specified.
